fomod.Name: CLAW - Configurable Lycanthrope Anatomy and Weight
fomod.Author: Vhodnoylogin
fomod.Description: CLAW requires HIMBO male and CBBE female bodies; choose CBBE or CBBE+3BA. Human linkage is mandatory; Vanilla support is deferred. One CommonLib DLL; SE 1.7.104.0 mechanisms tested. Other declared runtimes retain offline coverage. All six comparison presets have owner-confirmed visible differences.
